name: Voyageurs du Monde SA
summary: Voyageurs du Monde SA operates as a travel agency in France and internationally. The company organizes honeymoons, family holidays, romantic weekend trips, summer holidays, cruise tours, world tours, diving, and trips to Japan, Italy, Egypt, Australia, South Africa, Indonesia, the United States, Brazil, and Greece. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Paris, France. Voyageurs du Monde SA operates as a subsidiary of Avantage SA.
